description: This file is a shell script containing functions to manage Git repository worktrees, handle pull request metadata, and interact with GitHub APIs. It provides utilities for initializing, navigating, and cleaning up worktrees associated with pull requests, as well as retrieving PR details and statuses.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines and returns the canonical root directory of the Git repository, resolving from the common Git directory or fallback to parent directory.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Enters the worktree for a specific pull request, creating it if necessary, and optionally resets the branch to main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches the detailed metadata for a PR using GitHub CLI and returns the JSON output.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Parses PR JSON data and writes various PR metadata fields to files for further use.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all PR-related worktrees in the repository, displaying PR number, directory, and status information.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of merged or closed PR worktrees, optionally in dry-run mode.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a worktree directory name.
